The structure of Mn6V6S10 (reduced formula Mn3V3S5) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R3m (No. 160), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over 9 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mn and V centers each with 5 S neighbors, while S centers adopt 4- or 5-coordinate environments. Polyhedron-sharing analysis shows corner- and edge-sharing between 5-vertex S and 5-vertex Mn polyhedra, and corner-sharing between 5-vertex S and 4-vertex Mn polyhedra, forming a 3-periodic neighbor graph.
